reviewNotes: HOLD — Kuwait University's College of Medicine has a real seven-year medicine course leading to the Doctor of Medicine degree. The College describes a staged programme in which candidates who obtain the Kuwait University B.Med.Sc. may proceed to clinical study toward the MD. Kuwait University's official 2025/26 admissions rules require at least 85% secondary-school results for Medicine and weight English and mathematics aptitude tests. The university's 2026/27 public notice specifically covers Kuwaiti applicants, including Kuwaiti holders of certificates from outside Kuwait. No official current pathway for general international applicants, fee schedule, explicit programme teaching-language statement, international accommodation/support package, or audience-relevant recognition/licensing route was found. The candidate is held rather than published as a study-abroad option.
